title: Unit 15 Review: AI & Digital Ethics
goal: Consolidate opinion-verb mood, formal prepositional phrases, rhetorical clefts, reported mandates and dar por in digital ethics.

items: I can evaluate technological claims using formal opinion verbs across indicative and subjunctive.
I can connect data-governance arguments with formal prepositional phrases and contrastive clefts.
I can report regulatory mandates with passive *se* and accurate subjunctive tense sequence.
I can challenge unexamined digital-ethics assumptions with *dar por* + participle.
